seoTitle: Sprite Sheet Packer (PNG Atlas with JSON and CSS Map)
metaDescription: Pack many images into one sprite sheet PNG and get a JSON map of each sprite name, position and size, plus ready CSS classes for use on a page.
intro: Pack images into one sprite sheet with a JSON and CSS map.
why:
Choose many images. The tool packs them into rows on one PNG, tallest first, with padding you choose, and gives you a JSON map of each sprite name, position and size plus CSS classes that show a single sprite from the sheet.

It is a simple shelf packer, so it is not the tightest possible layout. Names come from file names, and duplicates are numbered.
howTo: Set the maximum width and padding.
Optionally round to powers of two.
Download the PNG and JSON, and copy the CSS.

faq.a: A frames map with frame x, y, w, h and sourceSize, close to the common atlas layout. Check your engine's loader.
Some older GPUs and engines prefer it.
